info.title: NOCTUA 1.0.0 - see your MediatR codebase.
info.description: See your MediatR codebase: CqrsLens statically scans a .NET solution (no build required) and generates an ARCHITECTURE.md report with Mermaid diagrams of your project graph, CQRS map, layers, and DbContexts.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Report path. Default: ARCHITECTURE.md (.html or .json) in the current
directory.

options.name: --format
options.description:
md (default), html, json, or agent. A matching -o extension implies the
format.

options.name: --render
options.description: HTML diagrams: mermaid (default) or svg (zero-JS inline SVG).

options.name: --export-svg
options.description:
Also write every diagram as a standalone .svg file into DIR (created
when missing).

options.description: Also write every diagram as a standalone .mmd file into DIR (created

options.name: --generated-at
options.description: Fixed timestamp for reproducible reports; timing is reported as 0 ms.

options.name: --analysis
options.description: text (default) or roslyn (opt-in).
